name: Nice & the French Riviera
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is hot, glamorous, and extremely crowded and expensive; the Cannes Film Festival in mid-May brings its own smaller spike.
overview: Nice's Promenade des Anglais, Monaco's casino glamour, and Cannes' red carpet — the Mediterranean coastline that defined the word "glamorous," now one of the world's premier yachting and celebrity destinations.
costOverview: Nice's old town keeps real budget options for food — Monaco and peak-season Cannes/Saint-Tropez are where this region becomes one of the most expensive stretches of coastline on Earth.

specialSeasons.text: The Cannes Film Festival (mid-May) brings global media attention and a huge spike in hotel prices along the whole coast.
